chars.HUDA: HUDA: a young Moroccan woman, about 22, long dark hair in a high ponytail, oversized pastel pink hoodie with a small cartoon cat print, light blue jeans
chars.MAMA: MAMA: a plump Moroccan mother in her 50s wearing a mustard yellow djellaba, a white headscarf and round gold-rimmed glasses
chars.MINHO: MINHO: a handsome young Korean man with silver-dyed undercut hair, black turtleneck and a long beige trench coat

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Comic 2D cartoon. In a traditional Moroccan salon in Kenitra with long patterned banquette sofas and a brass tea tray, HUDA proudly holds her phone up toward MAMA; MAMA stares back in total shock with both hands on her cheeks and her mouth wide open. Both fully in frame in the centre, facing each other, open tension, funny expressions.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Comic 2D cartoon. Same Moroccan salon. HUDA sits on the banquette smiling shyly and twisting her ponytail, blushing; MAMA sits next to her leaning in with a curious, hopeful smile, eyebrows raised, as if hearing about a marriage proposal.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Comic 2D cartoon. HUDA shows the phone screen to MAMA (the screen faces away from the viewer); MAMA squints suspiciously through her gold-rimmed glasses, pushing them up her nose, leaning very close to the phone. Moroccan salon background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Comic 2D cartoon. MAMA jerks back on the sofa with huge bulging eyes and her glasses slipping off her nose, pointing at HUDA in disbelief; HUDA grins nervously with a sweat drop. Moroccan salon background.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Dreamy romantic 2D cartoon daydream. HUDA and MINHO stand facing each other under pink cherry blossom trees on a Seoul street at sunset, petals falling, MINHO offering her a single flower, HUDA with sparkling eyes and hands clasped, like a romantic drama scene.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Comic 2D cartoon. MAMA stands in the Moroccan salon waving both arms dramatically and lecturing with an outraged face; HUDA sits on the banquette looking up at her, holding back a laugh. Kitchen doorway and patterned zellige tiles in the background.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Comic 2D cartoon. HUDA bursts out laughing on the banquette, holding her belly, kicking her feet; MAMA stands next to her with arms crossed and a furious, unimpressed frown. Moroccan salon.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Dramatic comic 2D cartoon. MAMA has jumped up from the sofa, frozen in shock, one hand on her chest, eyes wide; HUDA's smile has vanished, she looks up at her mother worried, phone in her lap. Tense mood, slightly darker evening light in the Moroccan salon.
